name: Captain Vanilla
original_name: キャプテン バニラ
source:
A Captain Vanilla type monster girl. Captain Vanilla monster girls have the appearance of pirates. This Captain Vanilla lives on a ship with her friend a [url=http://vndb.org/c10477]Kusushi[/url] type monster girl. She fights against [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid[/url] and all the monster girls who ally with him.

She's sensitive about her height.
